title: Densities for scalar-valued BSDEs via unique continuation and backward uniqueness
summary: We give sufficient conditions ensuring that, at every fixed positive time, the scalar backward component of a Markovian forward-backward stochastic differential equation with multidimensional forward process admits a density with respect to Lebesgue measure. Existing density criteria for BSDEs often obtain Malliavin non-degeneracy through sign or monotonicity assumptions. We develop a different route for a scalar backward component with an arbitrary-dimensional forward state.
